name: 講座の教材一覧
prompt:
Create ONE isolated Japanese course-material list of EXACTLY FOUR compact cards. Input1 ORIGINAL Coursera screenshot PRIMARY for icon glyph geometry, optical stroke, download-arrow anatomy, play glyphs, completion circle, alignment, spacing and visible states. Input2 mock SECONDARY Japanese text, values and locked typography; mock has missing completion/play icons and rough narrow download substitutes. Input3 Lighthouse finish only, no bus content. Original region x48 y605 width1082 height1122 in1179x2676. WHITE390x390 logical canvas; four white cardsx16width358height86,radius8 at y6,100,194,288 with8px vertical gaps. No extra headers/phone/dashboard/footer/fifth card.
All title text Meiryo Bold70014px line24, zero spacing, #1D1D1D atx32 and card top+12. Titles exact row1「第1回の補助教材」 row2「なぜプログラミングを学ぶのか」 row3「プログラムの開発」 row4「基本のデータ型」. Keep each on ONE line, room for right download icon.
Every card has original DOWNLOAD glyph nearx344,cardtop+20,about14x18, supporting slate #526173. Restore source broad outlined downward-arrow shaft/point with SEPARATE flat underline baseline; NOT mock's skinny rounded arrow, not a chevron or emoji. Same source geometry/optical weight on all four.
Two metadata pills atx32,y(cardtop+50),width66,height26 andx106,width60,height26,radius10,white surfaces,fine neutralborder. Exact row1「読む」「10分」; row2「映像」「15分」; row3「映像」「6分」; row4「映像」「32分」. Source row3 says16min but native Japanese value6分 is authored content and must stay6分. ALL metadata Meiryo REGULAR40014px line24 zero spacing, visibly lighter than bold titles.
RESTORE first row's small filled green completion-circle with white check left of「読む」inside first pill, and fine forest outlines on row1's completed reading/time pills. Badge forest #1F6444, preserves completion state. Rows2–4 first pill each restores source small OPEN outlined right-facing triangular PLAY glyph left of「映像」in slate #526173; no filled triangle or missing glyph. Fit icons+Japanese labels in66px compact width.
Ordinary cards rows1,3,4 fine neutral #E4E4E4 border. SELECTED row2 thin forest #1F6444 border, replacing original purple-blue selection outline. Row2 third pill atx174width84 whitefill, forest thinoutline, exact「次の教材」Regular14/24 foresttext; no mint fill. White ordinary surfaces, restrained shadow only if barely perceptible, coherent slate utility glyphs, no unnecessary green wash. Crisp accurate Japanese high-resolution flat UI raster.
reviewNotes: Completed check, play outlines, source-shaped slate download arrows and exact four-card content restored. Metadata Japanese labels/next tag and some times visibly too bold versus locked Regular14/24. One targeted typography correction required; raster only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
